Hi Gina — thanks for the packet, received and uploaded to our intake queue. Quick responses inline: 

- PO routing: We require a Redwood PO number on the invoice header (field label "PO #"). Please use our standard example formatting (see attached PO_Example_Formatting.pdf) so our AP parser picks up the number automatically. If a supplier can't embed it, route the invoice to ap@redwood.com with the PO in the email subject.
- Invoice delivery: PDF emailed to ap@redwood.com is preferred. We also support vendor portal upload; we can enable Neptune's account after activation.
- Payment terms: For new vendors, Redwood default is Net45 while the onboarding verification completes and tax/KYC checks finish. Net30 is possible for strategic partners after procurement + finance sign-off.

Regarding early-pay: We run a pilot (AP FastPay) that evaluates requests case-by-case. Typical structures: 1% discount for early settlement (14-day) or a small fee for guaranteed accelerated remit. I'll loop Procurement (Marissa) and AP (Naomi) to see if Neptune's volumes qualify and what the costing/approval path looks like. 

Action items from our side: 
1) Marissa — can you evaluate Neptune's expected monthly invoice run-rate against the FastPay eligibility thresholds?
2) Naomi — once we confirm volume, can AP model the cost (vs. margin) and provide the standard enrollment matrix?
3) Gina — can you confirm estimated monthly invoiced amount and whether Neptune needs the early-pay on a per-invoice basis or as an enrollment program?

If it helps, we can provisionally activate Neptune on Net45 and then move to Net30 + FastPay if approvals clear. Typical activation -> first PO timeline is 7-10 business days after final docs (bank details, signed MSA if applicable, and portal access).
